product_one_liner.value: Multiplier equips its portfolio of professional-services firms with custom AI and workflow technology that automates routine work and helps their tax, accounting, finance, and advisory professionals serve more clients.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage says its platform scales professional-services firms through technology and AI, while the technology page describes custom end-to-end workflows and AI-driven automation. Together these support the one-sentence description of what it does and who uses it.

pricing_page.notes: The company homepage’s navigation and footer list portfolio, ideas, careers, about, contact, privacy, terms, and cookies, but no pricing link; the official site therefore does not publicly advertise a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company homepage pairs Citrine International Tax and Expat Tax Professionals with descriptions and first-person statements about their work with Multiplier, providing two named customer references. They are portfolio firms, so their status as “customers” is a modest interpretive risk. | named_customers.0: The homepage names Citrine International Tax and includes a testimonial from its Managing Director about Multiplier’s AI layer. | named_customers.1: The homepage names Expat Tax Professionals and includes its CEO and Founder’s statement about the Multiplier partnership.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company information reports 37 employees (and an 11–50 company-size range); 37 maps to the requested 21–50 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Multiplier Holdings profile identifies the headquarters city as Singapore. | hq_country: The Multiplier Holdings profile gives its headquarters as Singapore, Singapore.

founded_year.notes: The PitchBook company profile identifies Multiplier Holdings and states that it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The official Ideas index presents editorial pieces about professional-services strategy, careers, and human outcomes; even its item tagged Technology is described as an argument about professional services, not how the product is built. It does not show two engineering/technical posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The official homepage navigation and footer show no documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link; the public pages found are marketing, careers, and legal pages rather than a multi-article documentation site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open Ashby board lists six roles, including four engineering roles, and their titles are product/design/engineering rather than AI, ML, data science, NLP, LLM, or related AI/ML titles.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Multiplier Holdings’ privacy policy says its personal-data transfers comply with applicable data-protection laws and specifically refers to the UK GDPR. Of the listed items, GDPR is the only one named in this claim; the policy does not identify SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS certifications. GDPR is not technically a certification, so this classification is somewhat interpretive. | compliance_certs.0: The privacy policy expressly refers to the UK GDPR in the context of compliant personal-data transfers.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding announcement explicitly identifies the $35 million round as Series B. | funding_date: The funding announcement is dated August 4, 2026, so the month of the most recent reported round is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The Multiplier Business Wire announcement states that it raised $35 million in its Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The $35 million Series B announcement is dated August 4, 2026, inside the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board has a Sales & Business Development Associate role, but its title is not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive; none of the other listed titles meets the specified role-title criteria.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable Ideas/news index shows the latest dated company article as “The Cathedral and the Casino” (September 2, 2026), an editorial piece, and its launch-related news links concern the company’s 2025 public launch. No product or major-feature launch announcement appears in the company’s readable post history during the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Multiplier’s August 4, 2026 funding announcement says Allen Shim joined as President and CFO, a C-level leadership appointment within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The current Sales & Business Development Associate posting for Rooled explicitly says to maintain the CRM, naming HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.0: The active job posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as the CRM maintained for the role.
